an5.159:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an5.159:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā udāyī mahatiyā gihīparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti.
an5.159:1.4: addasā kho āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ mahatiyā gihīparisāya parivutaṃ dhammaṃ desentaṃ nisinnaṃ.
an5.159:1.5: disvāna yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an5.159:1.6: āyasmā bhante udāyī mahatiyā gihīparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desetīti.
an5.159:2.1: na kho ānanda sukaraṃ paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ.
an5.159:2.2: paresaṃ ānanda dhammaṃ desentena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.
an5.159:2.5: pariyāyadassāvī kathaṃ kathessāmīti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbā.
an5.159:2.6: anuddayataṃ paṭicca kathaṃ kathessāmīti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.
an5.159:2.7: na āmisantaro kathaṃ kathessāmīti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.
an5.159:2.8: attānaṃ ca paraṃ ca anupahacca kathaṃ kathessāmīti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.
an5.159:2.9: na kho ānanda sukaraṃ paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ.
an5.159:2.10: paresaṃ ānanda dhammaṃ desentena ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā paresaṃ dhammo desetabboti.
